description: This file is a test module using pytest framework for testing SQLite project templates and initialization logic. It creates fixtures for temporary directories and template structures, defines multiple test cases for verifying template content, project initialization, database creation, default parameter handling, and configuration loading. It also includes tests for template variable substitution and SQLite-specific features. The code extensively interacts with generated Python scripts, fixture data, and ensures the correctness of project scaffolding for SQLite databases.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture creating a temporary directory for tests

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture creating a mock template directory with config, scripts, and README

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture constructing a sample project configuration for tests

methods.name: test_sqlite_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that template init info is correctly retrieved from the SQLite template

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that project files are generated and contain correct variable replacements

methods.name: test_database_creation(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that initializing the database creates the correct schema and data

methods.name: test_default_database_name(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Check the behavior when database name parameter is missing, ensuring a reasonable default is used

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Verify that post-processing scripts are executed and produce expected side effects

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Test loading project configuration from a JSON file

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that placeholders in template files are correctly replaced with actual project parameters

methods.name: test_sqlite_specific_features(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensure SQLite-specific behaviors, such as no need for user credentials, are handled correctly

methods.name: test_entry_point_url(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Check that the entry point URL is generated properly with correct database name
